concerns.text: T006's paired sign-flip permutation test over 5 GroupKFold folds has a minimum achievable two-sided p-value of 2/2^5 = 0.0625, so SC-002's α ≤ 0.05 threshold is mathematically unreachable if the test is two-sided. The task does not state sidedness. Specify one-sided testing (min p = 1/32 ≈ 0.031) or increase the number of paired units (e.g., repeated GroupKFold with multiple seeds to get >5 fold-level differences), otherwise T006's verification ('reports whether α ≤ 0.05') can never pass.

T015's verification is 'the documented command executes the full workflow from data fetch to final report without errors', but T015 is an independent Phase-1 setup task while the pipeline modules (T001–T012) do not yet exist. The verification is not executable at task time. Restate verification as: quickstart.md exists, names the exact commands, and the commands match those implemented in T012's end-to-end re-run (cross-checked there).

T014 requires a 'strict 80 % train / 20 % held-out split respecting source_id' but gives no rule for how group sizes are allocated to hit the proportion (greedy largest-first? seeded assignment?). With few or uneven source_id groups an exact 80/20 may be impossible; specify the allocation rule and a tolerance (e.g., 80% ± 5% of rows) so the verification 'respects the 80/20 proportion' is deterministically checkable.

T011 (research_notes.md) names its deliverable and content but has no explicit verification clause, unlike every other task. Add one, e.g., 'Verification: every claim in research_notes.md links to an existing file under data/results/ or outputs/figures/ (link targets all exist).' Otherwise done-ness is unjudgeable.
